業績                                       RESULTS
2020年回顧                                  Review for 2020
2020 年，新冠疫情的爆發對全球的社會經濟造                  In 2020, the outbreak of the COVID-19 epidemic had a significant
成極大的影響。儘管國內外的經濟環境複雜多                     impact on the socio-economic condition of the world. Despite
變，中國GDP仍然首次突破人民幣100萬億元，                  the complex and volatile economic environment domestically and
取得了疫情抗擊和經濟發展的雙重勝利。                       internationally, the PRC’s GDP exceeded RMB100 trillion for the first
                                         time, achieving the dual victory of fighting against the epidemic and
                                         significant economic development.


「 房 住 不 炒 」首 次 寫 入 五 年 規 劃 ， 貨 幣 政 策 趨   As “Homes are for living in, not for speculation” was included into the
穩，房地產調控持續加碼。「三條紅線」房地產                    five-year plan for the first time, monetary policies became stabilised
開發企業融資管理新規、商業銀行房地產貸款                     and there were increasing real estate regulations. Policies such as the
集中度管理、22熱點城市土地出讓「兩集中」等                   “Three Red Lines (三條紅線)”, the New Regulations on Management of
政策先後出台，反映出中央政府堅持「房住不                     Financing for Real Estate Development Enterprises (房地產開發企業融

序。內部審核部門的成員與高級管理層若干成          is responsible for the annual risk reporting process. Members of the

   2.23 撥備及或然負債                                      2.23 Provisions and contingent liabilities
          倘本集團因過往事件而現時須承擔法定                                Provisions are recognised when: the Group has a present legal or
          或推定責任，且履行該等責任可能須動                                constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is more likely
          用資源，及所涉及的金額能可靠估計                                 than not that an outflow of resources will be required to settle
          時，則確認撥備。未來營運虧損毋須確                                the obligation; and the amount has been reliably estimated.
          認撥備。                                             Provisions are not recognised for future operating losses.


          倘存在多項相若責任時，履行該等責任                                Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood
          是否需要動用資源在考慮整體責任之類                                that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by
          別後釐定。即使同一類別之任何一項責                                considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is
          任可能須動用資源的可能性極低，亦須                                recognised even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to
          確認撥備。                                            any one item included in the same class of obligations may be
                                                           small.


          撥備按管理層對於報告期間結算日對須                                Provisions are measured at the present value of management’s
          償付現有責任的最佳估計支出的的現值                                best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the present
          計量。用於釐定現值的貼現率為反映當                                obligation at the end of the reporting period. The discount rate
          時市場對金錢時間值及負債特定風險的                                used to determine the present value is a pre-tax rate that reflects
          評估的稅前利率。隨時間增加的撥備確                                current market assessments of the time value of money and the
          認為利息開支。                                          risks specific to the liability. The increase in the provision due to
                                                           the passage of time is recognised as interest expense.


          或然負債乃一項因過往事件可能產生的                                A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from
          責任，而該責任的存在僅可由一項或多                                past events and whose existence will only be confirmed by the
          項並非由本集團全權控制之日後不明朗                                occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more uncertain future
          事件之存在與否確定。或然負債亦可為                                events not wholly within the control of the Group. It can also
          因不大可能需要動用經濟資源或承擔之                                be a present obligation arising from past events that is not
          金額未能可靠地估量而未確認之過往事                                recognised because it is probable that outflow of economic
          件產生之現有承擔。                                        resources will not be required or the amount of obligation
                                                           cannot be measured reliably.


          或然負債不予確認，但會於合併財務報                                A contingent liability is not recognised but is disclosed in the
          表附註中披露。倘支付之可能性出現變                                notes to the consolidated financial statements. When a change
          動致使有可能需支付，則或然負債將確                                in the probability of an outflow occurs so that outflow is
          認為撥備。                                            probable, it will then be recognised as a provision.

       本集團的資本管理的目標乃為保障本集                                    The Group’s objectives when managing capital are to safeguard
       團能繼續營運，以為股東提供回報和維                                    the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to
       持最佳的資本結構以降低資金成本。                                     provide returns for shareholders and to maintain an optimal
                                                            capital structure to reduce the cost of capital.


       為維持或調整資本結構，本集團可能會                                    In order to maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group
       調整支付予股東的股息金額、發行新股                                    may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders, issue
       份或出售資產以減少債務。                                         new shares or sell assets to reduce debt.


       本集團利用資產負債比率監察其資本。                                    The Group monitors capital on the basis of the gearing ratio.
       此比率按照債務淨額除以資本總額計                                     This ratio is calculated as net debt divided by total capital.
       算。債務淨額為借款總額減去現金及現                                    Net debt is calculated as total borrowings less cash and cash
       金等價物。資本總額按合併財務狀況表                                    equivalents. Total capital is calculated as total equity, as shown
       所列示的權益總額加上債務淨額計算。                                    in the consolidated statement of financial position, plus net
                                                            debt.
